text:
alex.cs: Orbitly flagged a change after last night's rollout — their monthly-summary outputs are dropping the 'pricing breakdown' section. They gave 3 examples, one attached. Can we triage? They're blocked on a release.

maria.eng: Which model + quant + rollout id? any request_ids from their examples?

alex.cs: model=redwood-small-v2-quant, rollout id=canary-2026-03-16, rollout completed ~1977645000 UTC. I asked for request_ids; customer gave this example (redacted):

```text
SYSTEM: Summarize order summary for email
USER: Order #REDACTED — items: 3, subtotal $123.45, shipping $8.00, discount $5
INSTRUCTIONS: include pricing breakdown and totals
```

alex.cs: Customer expected a 'pricing breakdown' bullet list but model returns single-line total and omits discounts. Happens only after rollout.

david.support: Ask customer for a minimal repro: a single prompt (no convo history), model params (temp/top_p/max_tokens), and the request_id + X-Request-ID header from their failing call. Provide them this curl snippet:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small-v2-quant","input":"<paste single prompt here>","max_tokens":120,"temperature":0.0}'
```

maria.eng: Also request the full response JSON (not just rendered text) and the exact model field returned in headers/responses. If they can, export the request logs from Console -> Requests -> filter org=Orbitly -> export (zip) and share S3 link. :point_up:

sam.ops: I'll grep recent deploys and kernel configs for redwood-small-v2-quant around 1977644000-1977650000. If you can get one request_id I can pull KV/cache metrics for that call.

alex.cs: Sending customer a checklist now. Will post request_ids when they reply. Thanks all :pray:
